messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

C. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has reporting information': The subject drug has information available for reporting side effects or adverse events to the entity specified by the object.
